title: Interior balcony and gallery means of egress.
officialText: For balconies, galleries or press boxes having a seating capacity of 50 or more located in Group A occupancies, at least two means of egress shall be provided, with one from each side of every balcony, gallery, or press box and at least one leading directly to an exit.
